key_idea: Order is preserved, so target positions p_1<p_2<...<p_n; substituting y_i = p_i - i makes y non-decreasing and the problem becomes L2 isotonic regression of a_i = x_i - i, solved by pool-adjacent-violators with integer block values.
sketch: Maintain a stack of blocks (sum, count, value) where value is the integer nearest to the block mean; push each a_i as its own block and merge with the previous block while the previous value exceeds the current one, recomputing the rounded mean. Finally sum (value - a_i)^2 over all elements. O(n) amortised, fine for n = 1e6. Pitfalls: rounding the mean needs floor division that is correct for negative sums; the answer reaches about n^3/12 = 8.3e16 so 64-bit is required; use fast input. Stress-tested against an O(n * range) DP on 400 small random cases.
